title: The devil in the (de)tails: an improved recovery guarantee for sparse approximation
summary: Many functions exhibit approximate sparsity in their coefficients with respect to a given dictionary. In recent literature, sparse approximation in such a dictionary from i.i.d. pointwise samples, underpinned by compressed sensing, has become a powerful tool for high-dimensional function approximation. A key step in this framework is truncating the (typically countably-infinite) dictionary to a finite index set of size $n$, so that compressed sensing tools can be used to approximate the function by a sparse combination of these truncated dictionary elements.
